payload.text: Two +2.00 μC point charges are 0.400 m apart; consider their midpoint.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Design a feasible measurement that tests the governing relation; identify the independent variable, dependent variable, and one control.

criteria.description: A feasible measurement design: sweep a field probe (or small test charge) along the line joining the two charges and record the net electric field magnitude (or potential) at each position. Independent variable = position along the line joining the two charges; dependent variable = measured net field magnitude (or potential) at that position; control = the charge magnitudes (2.00 μC each) and their 0.400 m separation, held fixed across trials.
